name: smiles
description: One question customer satisfaction, running entirely on bunny.net.

scripts.build: npm run build:edge && npm run build:site
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:widget && npm run deploy:site
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build:edge && cd api && bunny scripts deploy ../dist/api.js
scripts.deploy:widget: npm run build:edge && cd widget && bunny scripts deploy ../dist/widget.js
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && bunny sites deploy ./site/dist
